ideas.pitch: A fast decision-tree and minimax-based AI agent that evaluates state spaces and computes optimal damage-to-risk ratios for autonomous Pokémon combat.
ideas.problem_statement: ARESxShunya Pokémon AI Battle: Develop an AI agent to control a team of three Pokémon autonomously using the battle API and local simulator.
ideas.title: AlphaMon Heuristic Evaluator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on deterministic decision-making trees rather than heavy training, ensuring zero timeout latency during live tournament execution.

ideas.pitch: A reinforcement learning agent trained on the local simulator using tabular Q-learning to master type matchups, move priorities, and strategic switching.
ideas.problem_statement: ARESxShunya Pokémon AI Battle: Develop and test an AI agent using machine learning, reinforcement learning, or probability-based methods.
ideas.title: Q-Learning Type-Advantage Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages actual ML training within the short hackathon window to outperform naive baseline agents by exploiting state transition probabilities.

ideas.pitch: A Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) agent that simulates future turn rollouts to select the statistically optimal move under uncertainty.
ideas.problem_statement: ARESxShunya Pokémon AI Battle: AI receives current battle state, selects an action, and the battle engine executes it autonomously.
ideas.title: Stateful Monte Carlo Pokémon Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: MCTS excels in turn-based game trees with hidden information or probabilistic move hits, giving a distinct advantage in strategic depth.

ideas.pitch: A hybrid heuristic agent combining strict defensive type-chart matching with predictive switch triggers when HP thresholds drop below critical levels.
ideas.problem_statement: ARESxShunya Pokémon AI Battle: The AI receives the current battle state and selects a legal move or switches Pokémon.
ideas.title: Rule-Engineered Meta-Switcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Simple, robust rule sets often crush unstable machine learning agents during rapid 3-hour implementation windows due to zero training overhead.

ideas.pitch: An ensemble controller that blends a defensive heuristic layer for emergency healing/switching with an aggressive damage-maximization policy network.
ideas.problem_statement: ARESxShunya Pokémon AI Battle: Develop an AI agent to control them autonomously using machine learning, probability-based methods, or heuristics.
ideas.title: Ensemble State Machine AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Multi-layered fallback logic prevents catastrophic edge-case failures during the live tournament rounds where simpler scripts lock up.
